summary: Dependency-free QR encoder producing a Texture2D. Versions 1-4, error correction level M.
overview: Generates a QR code as a Texture2D with no external library and no camera or scanner integration — for "scan to continue on your phone" flows. Scope is deliberately narrow: versions 1 to 4, error correction level M, alphanumeric or byte mode chosen automatically.
useCases: A kiosk handing a session off to the visitor's phone.
Showing a short URL or code that is easier to scan than to type.
A printed or on-screen code generated from runtime data.

gotchas.title: Scan-test the first code before relying on it
gotchas.body: The Reed-Solomon maths, the bit-stream construction against the published worked example, and the format-info computation are all covered by the self-test. The exact module placement — where the finder, timing and alignment patterns sit — was written from the standard algorithm rather than copied from a checked reference, and cannot be verified without a real scanner.

gotchas.title: A quiet zone is included and is not optional
gotchas.body: The blank border is part of the spec. Cropping it, or drawing the texture edge-to-edge against busy art, can stop a scanner locking on.

gotchas.title: Capacity is small at versions 1-4
gotchas.body: Long URLs will not fit. Shorten the link rather than expecting it to scale.
